title: Yellowed Bitter Saudi Arabian Spaghetti Pasta
description: A unique and bitter Saudi Arabian dish featuring spaghetti, nuka-pickle, and a blend of spices, perfect for a midnight craving. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Stir in the chopped nuka-pickle and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked spaghetti and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the spice and nuka-pickle mixture.
Transfer the spaghetti mixture to a donabe vessel and serve hot.
Garnish with additional nuka-pickle and spices if desired.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
